query:
WITH the_comment AS (
                DELETE FROM comments
                WHERE
                    id = $1 AND
                    post_id IN (SELECT id FROM posts WHERE id = $2) AND
                    user_id = $3
                RETURNING 1
            )
            SELECT
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM comments
                    INNER JOIN posts ON posts.id = comments.post_id
                    WHERE comments.id = $1 AND posts.id = $2
                ) "existed!",
                EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1 FROM the_comment
                ) "deleted!"
